findings.summary: Resolved dependency graph contains install-time scripts
findings.detail: The exact npm lockfile marks one or more reachable dependencies as having an install-time lifecycle script. Scripts were disabled during this review; a normal DSH installation may execute or stop on these scripts.
findings.remediation: Review each listed package and its published artifact; prefer a version with no install-time script, or require explicit approval before allowing the DSH install path to run it.

findings.summary: npm artifact has no build provenance
findings.detail: The published bytes are not cryptographically linked to a declared source commit and build workflow.
findings.remediation: Enable npm provenance at publication with `npm publish --provenance` or `NPM_CONFIG_PROVENANCE=true`; GitHub Actions publishers also need `id-token: write`. Re-run `inspect --deep` on the next exact version.
